steps.title: Define and check one row per order
steps.change: Several detail rows can belong to one order. Count the lines, count each distinct product once, and add the quantities. All three metrics come from OrderDetails.
steps.added_sql:
select OrderID,count(OrderID)  as line_items, count(distinct(ProductID)) as distinct_products,
sum(Quantity) as total_units
from OrderDetails
group by OrderID
order by OrderID;
steps.sql:
select OrderID,count(OrderID)  as line_items, count(distinct(ProductID)) as distinct_products,
sum(Quantity) as total_units
from OrderDetails
group by OrderID
order by OrderID;

steps.title: Apply the cutoff and sort
steps.change: HAVING checks the group count after aggregation. The order ID gives a consistent result for tied counts.
steps.added_sql:
having count(OrderID) > 8
order by count(OrderID) desc ,OrderID asc
